name: hv16_dbk_vp4_ctl_rt80

job.purpose: DMA STORE back controller leaf for the d4g die: RR_RT 80 (VM read round trip at the controller pins, d4g budget: faces bank pin flop + GEN2c lanes 33..58, worst-case landing E 72, GEN2d headroom; die pads the 17-bit rq lanes). Landing slot = landing counter, response mask rebuilt from 2 delayed bits/edge (issued, last partial column); minimum drain lag RR_RT+3 enforced. ONE master for all four quadrants (stk strap). Bench: tb_dma_vp4_banklat faces bank model + GEN2c NE lanes padded to 80 PASS through the real landing SRAMs; mutants old latency 7 / pad short / lag-1 FAIL. Pins/faces = HH-7 per-face controller (bank_read_addr/slots split S/W/N, claude/hh7-dbkcpl-1019).

benches.name: lint
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_controller #(.RR_RT(80)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/static/ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/static/ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp_banks.sv && echo lint-ok

structural_change: HBM-BANKLAT-DMA 10-19: RR_RT parameter (default 7 = closed hv15_dbk_vp4_ctl, byte-identical path). At RR_RT 80: +2x81 delay flops + 7-bit landing counter; 8-deep expect_tag/expect_mask swept; lag check RR_RT+3. Same ports/pins.

reroute_reason.why_route: d4g faces banks + GEN2c relay lanes: DMA VM read round trip 33..58 (worst E 72) vs the closed view fixed 7; new parameterised view RR_RT 80 (closed hv15_dbk_vp4_ctl stays for RR_RT 7).

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every data input at the pin (a_mv/a_ci/a_cd/a_cb/a_ce, cycle_q, wa_q, wb_ready_q, rr_valid capture, stk_q) and drives every output from a flop; rst_n enters the local 2-flop reset_meta/reset_ready synchroniser; a wrapper stage would add +1/+1 to the compiled DESC_LAT4 schedule for nothing
